watch_pull_request: Watch an open PR for this thread, linking it if needed. T3 wakes you on failed checks, passed required checks, new comments or reviews, conflicts, and once on merge or close unless you did it via CLI. Handle old comments first; only new ones wake you. After this call, end your turn. The watch stays on: do not call this again on a wake. A wake is not a merge decision. Check readiness yourself.
